arStrings.szText: "What can you tell me about the Butcher?"
It seems that the Archbishop Lazarus goaded many of the townsmen into venturing into the Labyrinth to find the king's missing son.

He played upon their fears and whipped them into a frenzied mob. None of them were prepared for what lay within the Cold Earth... Lazarus abandoned them down there—left in the clutches of unspeakable horrors—to die.
